out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the dish machine area and pizza area being used to hold dirty trays and trays and buckets
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands.CFM relocated trays and buckets and clear and clean the hand sink areas. UNO PIZZERIA & GRILL (Inspection Date: 08/25/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Observed raw shell eggs in unit # 10 on top of Shredded cheese
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFm relocated the raw shell eggs to the bottom shelf.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: Ice machine soiled on the frame door.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM emptied the ice machine and will clean and sanitized properly.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Raw chicken in unit # 9 at 48F, sliced tomato, shredded cheese, cooked chicken in unit # 4 at 44, 49, 48F, Chicken wings in unit #6 at 51F,
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Observed Raw chicken from unit # 9, sliced tomato, shredded cheese, cooked chicken from unit # 4, Chicken wings from unit #6

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP salmon thawing in unit # 10 in the intact package
violations.corrective_action: Employee open package to air.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: Unit # 4 at 43F and Unit # 6 at 51F
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. CFM will not use the units until they are repaired.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the drains in the kitchen are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. CFM will clean and disinfect the drains

violations.title: Mops Allowed to Air Dry
violations.observation: Observed that mops are improperly stored between use. Observed mops store on mop buckets
violations.corrective_action: Store mops in a position that allows them to air dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. CFM relocated mop to rack to allow air dry

violations.title: Cleaning Procedure
violations.observation: Observed food employees using improper handwashing procedures. Observed the chef washing hands without using soap and not drying them properly before putting on new gloves.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wash their hands and exposed portions of their arms by: 1) discarding used gloves; 2) rinsing under warm running water; 3) applying soap; 4) rubbing together for at least 10-15 seconds; 5) rinsing thoroughly under warm running water; and 6) drying with paper towels or air drying device. EHS provided handwashing training , CFM asked employee to wash his hands properly.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed sour cream, tomato sauce (top) in unit # 7 at 45, 46F, Cooked beef on counter at 69F, raw Milanese chicken in unit # 5 at 48F, Boiled eggs, heavy cream, salad, whipped cream in unit # 3 at 46, 54, 54,54F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded sour cream, tomato sauce (top) from unit # 7, Cooked beef on counter, raw Milanese chicken from unit # 5, Boiled eggs, heavy cream, salad, whipped cream and all TCS foods from unit # 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at bar handwashing sink.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC provided hand soap at all hand sinks.

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the bar being used to store blender and scouring brushes.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC removed all items from hand sink and trained staff on proper use of hand sinks.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw ground beef stored above grilled chicken in 2 door prep unit (L) on cook line; raw shrimp stored above macaroni and cheese in 2 door prep unit (R) on cook line; raw shell egg stored above garlic in Walk In Cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC placed all raw animal foods below all foods that are ready to eat.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: glassware from bar dish machine registering below 50 ppm of bleach sanitizer.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. PIC sent all equipment to primary dish machine for proper sanitization.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: sliced ham (45F, after 4 hours) in walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). PIC discarded sliced ham.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: marinara sauce (45F), cooked cavatappi (45F), pico de gallo (45F) in walk in cooler; milk (45-47F) in 2 door flattop at expo; salsa (48F) in 2 door prep at expo; cooked eggplant (45F), mashed potato (45F) in 2 door pizza prep (R).
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC discarded all items. UNO PIZZERIA & GRILL (Inspection Date: 09/25/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticides
violations.observation: Restricted use pesticides do not meet the requirements in 40 CFR 152 Subpart 1 Classification of Pesticides. Observed “Ortho Home Defense” at back dry storage area of kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Restricted use pesticides that do not meet the requirements of 40 CFR 152 may be toxic, which may result in the contamination of food. These pesticides shall not be used. PIC discarded pesticide.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: bar dish machine registering below 10 ppm chlorine bleach; Walk in cooler observed at (45F).
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted refrigeration repair technician during inspection. Walk in cooler observed at 42F before end of inspection. PIC moved all TCS items from Walk In Cooler to Walk In Freezer until the repair of the Walk In Cooler is complete. PIC will contact EHS to conduct a site visit to ensure functionality of Walk In Cooler within 24 hours. A follow-up inspection will be conducted within 10 days to assess functionality of dish machine.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: doors and gaskets of all 2 door prep units on cook line and at pizza station; outer surfaces of pizza oven.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. PIC will deep clean all nonfood contact surfaces before follow-up within 10 days.

violations.title: Chemical Sanitization, Chlorine Requirements
violations.observation: When tested, the low temperature, chemical sanitizing warewashing machine was observed with a sanitizing rinse concentration of less than 50 ppm chlorine solution. Bar dish machine 0ppm
violations.corrective_action: Immediately discontinue use of the dishmachine. Until the machine is adequately repaired, set up the three-compartment sink to manually wash, rinse and sanitize food-contact surfaces using a sanitizing solution at the proper concentration of at least 50 to 200 ppm total chlorine. CFM will sanitized in the 3 compartment sink while dish machine is repair.

violations.title: Mechanical Warewashing, Hot Water Sanitization, 165F
violations.observation: The water temperature in the manifold servicing the high temperature warewashing machine was below the minimum allowable level of 165F for a stationary rack single temperature machine. The thermostat read 130 F
violations.corrective_action: In a mechanical operation the temperature of the fresh hot water sanitizing rinse as it enters the manifold may not be more than 194F or less than 165F for a stationary rack, single temperature machine or for all other machines, 180F. CFM will sanitize in the 3 compartment sink while dish machine is adjusted/repair.

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth.
